item.title: Solvent-solvent dipole engineering of a low-concentration electrolyte for high-performance wide-temperature sodium-ion batteries

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers solvent-solvent dipole engineering in low-concentration electrolytes, a strategy not previously applied to sodium-ion batteries. By tuning dipole interactions, it simultaneously overcomes poor low-temperature conductivity and high-temperature interfacial instability, enabling wide-temperature operation while cutting salt use and cost—advancing practical, sustainable sodium-ion battery deployment.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · low-concentration electrolyte · solvent-solvent dipole · wide-temperature · interfacial stability

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using chaotropic anions to tune ionic coordination and the dynamic electrode–electrolyte interface, suppressing zinc dendrites and hydrogen evolution. This enables stable alkaline zinc–nickel batteries with ultra-low negative-to-positive capacity ratio under high depth of discharge, advancing practical, low-cost aqueous energy storage.

item.title: Chaotropic Anions Unlock the Zn-ion Redox in Vanadium Carbide MXene
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Chaotropic anions enable Zn-ion redox in V2CTx MXene, overcoming its limited capacity and narrow anodic window in dilute electrolytes. This reveals anion-driven control of charge storage, linking electrolyte chemistry to MXene redox activity and offering a design principle for high-voltage, high-capacity aqueous Zn-ion energy storage.
🏷 vanadium carbide MXene · Zn-ion redox · chaotropic anions · water-in-salt electrolyte · pseudocapacitance

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Joule-heating synthesizes hierarchically porous carbon nanofibers/CoCr alloy as a self-supporting Li-CO2 battery cathode. This binder-free, conductive architecture enhances CO2 diffusion and catalytic kinetics, lowering charge overpotential and improving cycling stability. The approach offers a scalable route to efficient CO2 utilization and high-energy-density storage.

item.title: Competitive Coordination Decouples Charge Transport from Viscous Relaxation in Water-in-Salt Electrolytes
item.description:
افزودنی‌های زویتریونی در الکترولیت غلیظ LiTFSI با هماهنگی رقابتی، انتقال بار را از واهلش ویسکوز جدا کرده و رفتار سوپرآیونی ایجاد می‌کنند.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Zwitterionic additives in water-in-salt electrolytes decouple conductivity from viscosity, shifting them from subionic to superionic Walden behavior. This arises from competitive coordination: zwitterions bind Li⁺ yet weaken Li⁺–TFSI⁻ association, redistributing water. The work reveals a design route to independently tune solvation, ion correlations, and transport in concentrated electrolytes.
🏷 water-in-salt electrolyte · zwitterionic additive · LiTFSI · ion transport · Walden behavior

item.title: Multi-Step Oxygen Redox Mechanism in the Polyanionic Lithium-Rich Cathode Li2FeSiO4
item.description:
محاسبات DFT نشان می‌دهد در کاتد غنی از لیتیوم Li2FeSiO4، اکسیژن redox با مهاجرت Fe و تشکیل O2 همراه است و چارچوب پلی‌آنیونی مانع آن نمی‌شود.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This study overturns the assumption that polyanionic frameworks prevent O2 formation in lithium-rich cathodes. It reveals FeSiO4 decomposes via a multistep oxygen redox mechanism involving Fe migration, disproportionation, and O2 release, showing previously proposed mechanisms can act as steps in one process. This advances understanding of silicate cathode stability and guides design of durable lithium-rich materials.
🏷 Li2FeSiO4 · oxygen redox · lithium-rich cathode · DFT · O2 formation

item.title: Stress-adaptive conductive network and ion-segregated polymeric-inorganic interphases enable durable room-temperature silicon-based solid-state batteries
item.description:
این مقاله با شبکه رسانای تنش‌تطبیق‌پذیر و میان‌فازهای پلیمری-معدنی جداشده یونی، باتری‌های حالت جامد سیلیکونی پایدار در دمای اتاق را ممکن می‌سازد.
Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The work integrates a stress-adaptive Si-Zn-amorphous carbon anode with a salt-segregated PVDF-HFP electrolyte, creating a polymeric-inorganic bilayer interphase. This design decouples Si expansion, preserves electrical connectivity, and enables fast ion transfer, achieving 337 Wh kg−1 and long cycling (2000/800 cycles) at room temperature—advancing practical, durable silicon-based solid-state batteries.
